Messages.Author: GymNat1
Messages.Body:
must the vamp using MotS declare what equipment she is searching her library
for? If they don't have that equipment, the vamp doesn't get to choose a new
one...correct?

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <20001112232516...@ng-mf1.aol.com>,


Since it doesn't say "name a piece of equipment", I'd say the implied
wording is "choose a piece of equipment in your library."

So you can go through your library, then choose. In fact, when I see it
played, it's not uncommon to pick out several candidates, then shuffle
the rejected ones back in after the choice is made.

gomi

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
GymNat1 wrote:
> must the vamp using MotS declare what equipment she is searching her library
> for?

No. The successful action allows you to "go through your library [and] find
a piece of equipment..."
